**Skill this week:** calculating and mapping demographic rates. By the end of the week you should be able to normalize counts into rates, read a population pyramid, explain the demographic transition, and explain why crude rates can mislead.

## Map

Complete ArcGIS Online Exercises 2.1 Spatial distribution of population, 2.2 Fertility rates, 2.3 Death rates and natural increase, and 2.4 Population structure. The links are at [esri.com/Human-Geography](https://www.esri.com/Human-Geography).

For more practice: Exercise 2.5 The demographic transition in Latin America.

## Public health case

ACDIS measured adult life expectancy every year from 2000 to 2011. In 2003, before HIV treatment reached the public health system, it was 49.2 years; by 2011 it was 60.5 years.
